_comment: Seasonal offers announced by the JustFlip app (Today card, paywall label) and the homepage (#black-friday). The offer that started last and has no passed "end" is shown, so Black Friday hands over to Cyber Monday on its start, and Cyber Monday stays until you set its "end". "end": null means until further notice. theme: blackFriday | cyberMonday | anything else = generic special offer. plans: the discounted plans, the first is preselected on the paywall. The prices are set in App Store Connect (Lifetime price schedule; subscriptions as introductory offers, see ios/Tools/Offers/subscription-sale.py in the app repo). The app labels a plan only while the store backs it: Lifetime when it costs at most maxPriceVsYearly x Yearly, a subscription when the customer is offered a paid introductory price. To end the sale: set "end" on the running offer to an ISO date-time AND restore the price in App Store Connect on the same day.
